title: MarsWalk Campaign Progress Event Record
description: Schema for progress events occurring during simulated multi-sol campaign execution, linked to Sortie Black Box incident logging and dynamic replanning.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for campaign progress event with 'cpe_' prefix.

event_type.description: Lifecycle transition or operational progress event classification.

target_id.description: Target ID involved in event if applicable.

observation_id.description: Observation ID registered during this event if applicable.

details.description: Structured operational details or reason codes.

idempotency_key.description: Unique cryptographic or chronological key to prevent duplicate event ingestion.

black_box_event_id.description: Linked Sortie Black Box event ID in data/workspaces/events/.
